primary.title: How much equity is enough? A simple asset allocation guide for conservative investors
primary.summary: Volatile markets have led retail investors to reconsider their investment options amid inflation. Fixed deposits and debt funds carry lower risk, but the choice depends on individual tax slabs, financial timelines, and risk tolerance.
